source: Fantastical for events; Google Calendar for RSVP status

coverage.note: Some calendars and recurring events are deliberately excluded from this feed. A free window means nothing is scheduled that Arjen wants surfaced here — it is not a guarantee of an empty diary.

rsvp_policy.needs_action: Categorised as mantel_tbd — invited, not yet answered.
rsvp_policy.declined: Dropped from the feed entirely; the time reads as free.
rsvp_policy.free_transparent: Events marked as not blocking time are dropped.

categories.mantel: Committed Mantel work time. Accepted, or no RSVP applies.
categories.mantel_tbd: Invited but not yet answered. Treat as unresolved — it may become a commitment or disappear.
categories.optional_mantel: Mantel-adjacent: informational, drop-in or community, or answered as maybe. Moveable and skippable.
categories.personal: Personal commitment. Unavailable. No further detail is published.
